snippet.title: 🐣What The Hen: Summoner Spring! ENG Game Trailer 4 Google Play 30s
snippet.description:
Enjoy whacky, cartoony heroes? How about insane clan competitions, barbaric boss fights, crazy collectible character cards, and addictive Arena duels? If so, you’re in luck, summoner hatchling!

Battle epic hero duels in the brand new EASTER game update!

The all-new “What the Hen: Summoner Spring!” is bigger, better, and HENtastic in every possible way! Immerse yourself in the crazy chase after the mad chicken wizard in the most cartoon-styled game adventure EVER. In your epic summoner seance, duel the wackiest bosses and collect the most hilarious heroes throughout HUNDREDS of levels and THOUSANDS of 1on1 Arena battles! Enlist your personal army of Summoner Heroes, create or join the coolest clans, and battle in tailored, time-based special events in the most glorious update in the HENstory of mankind!
